title: Cambridge IELTS 13 Test 2 Writing Task 2
directions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write about the following topic:
prompt: Some people believe that nowadays we have too many choices.
scenario: Some people believe that nowadays we have too many choices.
requirements: To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
